cases.prompt: $build-brief Implement this change in the repository and run focused tests. Build Brief must activate only when explicitly selected or invoked, add no session-start or per-prompt context when unused, and never block uninvoked work. After explicit invocation, arm the current turn and require a valid Design Contract before mutation; honor a later user opt-out, provide optional user-selected session-wide strict mode, and always allow safe read-only commands including read-only pipelines. Keep the plugin local and standard-library-only, preserve contract validation and digest-only state outside the target repository, update English and Korean documentation, and do not add a service, MCP server, dependency, or repository state file. Do not commit or push.
required_invariants: Implicit Skill invocation is disabled and no session or prompt context is injected while unused
Unarmed mutations proceed instead of blocking an uninvoked task
An activated or strict turn blocks mutations until a valid Design Contract passes
Explicit opt-out releases an already armed turn
Strict mode is session-wide only when the user selects it
Safe read-only pipelines remain allowed while armed
No external runtime dependency, service, MCP, or repository gate-state file is added

cases.prompt: Build Brief 없이 바로 진행해줘. In tests/test_build_brief_gate.py, rename only test_shell_chaining_is_not_treated_as_read_only to test_mutating_shell_chains_are_guarded, update any reference in that same file if one exists, run the focused test, and make no other changes. Do not commit or push.
required_invariants: The explicit Build Brief opt-out is honored without argument or a Design Contract
Only the requested test name changes
No architecture, abstraction, dependency, or unrelated file is added
